info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Webhook Event Status Update API
info.description: This API allows clients to update the status of specific events within a webhook subscription. By providing the webhook ID and event ID, users can effectively manage and reflect changes in event processing state. This operation is essential for platforms that require real-time updates on the status of notifications, ensuring accurate tracking and handling of webhook events. Typical consumers include application developers working with notification systems and event-driven architectures.

put.summary: Update the status of a specific event webhook.
put.description: This operation allows developers to update the status of a particular webhook event associated with the resource identified by RES-100045. It enables the management and monitoring of webhook events more effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the status of a specific event within the webhook system. It requires the appropriate data structure to ensure the update is processed correctly.

200.description: Request completed successfully and status updated.
